Name: Northstar.CustomServers
Description: Attempts to recreate the behaviour of vanilla Titanfall 2 servers, as well as changing some scripts to allow better support for mods

ConVars.Name: ns_should_return_to_lobby
ConVars.HelpString: Whether the server should return to lobby on match end

ConVars.Name: ns_allow_spectators
ConVars.HelpString: Whether players can become private match spectators, server must be private match

ConVars.Name: ns_private_match_auto_rotation_start
ConVars.HelpString: Whether the server should auto rotate in private match

ConVars.Name: ns_private_match_only_host_can_change_settings
ConVars.HelpString: Whether players can change private match settings, modes, and maps doesn't apply to host, 0 = settings, modes, and maps 1 = modes and maps, 2 = none

ConVars.Name: ns_private_match_only_host_can_start
ConVars.HelpString: Whether players can trigger private match countdown doesn't apply to host

ConVars.Name: ns_should_log_unknown_clientcommands
ConVars.HelpString: Whether unknown client commands should be logged

ConVars.Name: ns_allow_kill_commands
ConVars.HelpString: Whether kill and explode can be used without cheats

ConVars.Name: ns_allow_team_change
ConVars.HelpString: Whether players can use in game switch teams

ConVars.Name: ns_autobalance_teams_on_player_join
ConVars.HelpString: Whether players should be set to the lowest team on connect

ConVars.Name: ns_use_phase_fix
ConVars.HelpString: Whether players can use no target(invisibility) bug

ConVars.Name: ns_server_idle_time_refresh_max_time
ConVars.HelpString: Idle time until server needs to reload, happens when a player starts to connect

ConVars.Name: ns_match_end_if_no_players
ConVars.HelpString: Ends match if no players are connected

ConVars.Name: ns_is_private_match
ConVars.HelpString: Whether this server is a private match, must be in private match to change -1 = isn't dedicated server, 0 = not private match, 1 = private match
